docs.text: Gym routine: squats, deadlifts and bench press three times a week. Rest 90 seconds between sets.
Monthly budget: rent first, then groceries, then save 20% of each paycheck into the emergency fund.
Atomic Habits notes: make the cue obvious, the craving attractive, the response easy, the reward satisfying.
Oaxaca trip: hotel downtown, try mezcal and tlayudas, visit Monte Albán early to avoid the heat.
Sleep log takeaways: no screens after 22:00, same wake-up time on weekends, coffee only before noon.
Car maintenance: oil change every 10,000 km, rotate tires every 8,000 km, check brake pads yearly.
